README: Owner-verified places that OpenStreetMap does not have (v43). build.py imports an entry ONLY if it has name, kind, category, lat, lon, source_url and verified_by. Use a coordinate you checked yourself (on site, or the business's own published map pin), not one copied from Google Maps. Example entry: {"name":"اربد مول جراند","name_en":"Irbid Mall Grand","kind":"mall","category":"Mall","lat":0,"lon":0,"source_url":"https://irbidmallgrand.com/","verified_by":"owner, on site","verified_on":"2026-10-20","aliases":["Irbid Mall"]}
